scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:backend && bun run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:frontend: cd frontend && bun install && bunx expo install --fix
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
